description.en: Inatter is the game's in-game social feed (its posts are listed in data/res/history/tweets_config.cfg.bin). Starts loading that file in the background, unless global bit flag 1418 is already set (the flag CMND_INATTER_CHECK_ADD sets). Wait for the load with CMND_INATTER_IS_LOADING, then call CMND_INATTER_CHECK_ADD. The ev_main helper Inatter_Check does the three steps.

Always false (the native pushes false whether or not it started a load).
null if the script system is not ready.
